title: Cheapguide
summary: Led backend systems and architecture in a 4-person cross-functional team, designing and shipping a Spring Boot backend with REST APIs for auth, posts, search, AI moderation, and notifications
highlights: Integrated Firebase Auth (JWT) for stateless token verification, enforcing endpoint authorisation and administrative privilege guards across 70+ protected REST endpoints
Researched and proposed replacing a Redis sidecar with Caffeine in-memory caching, eliminating ~$400/year in infrastructure overhead while achieving sub-millisecond data retrieval
Set up async workflows with Google Pub/Sub and tuned thread pools (16 concurrent threads), provisioning GCP infrastructure (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Storage) via Terraform
Established CI/CD with GitHub Actions utilising multi-stage Docker builds (reducing image size by ~40%) and ensured production monitoring with OpenTelemetry tracing and structured logging

title: ParkPie
summary: Led AI & backend engineering in a 6-person Agile team, architecting a geospatial-first Django backend leveraging AWS EC2, RDS (PostGIS), Cognito auth, and S3 for secure uploads
highlights: Designed a domain-driven PostgreSQL schema managing 1.9M+ geospatial records, separating runtime map state from immutable temporal history to ensure auditable data provenance via CQRS-inspired REST APIs
Architected a multi-step AI interpretation pipeline with LangChain, combining a dual-provider Gemini/Ollama model setup with PGVector semantic search for reliable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Engineered a DevSecOps CI/CD pipeline in GitHub Actions, enforcing Test-driven development across 600+ automated tests, Mypy strict type-checking, Bandit security scanning, and multi-stage Docker builds
Added comprehensive monitoring and tracing with LangSmith for LLM behaviour and OpenTelemetry + the Grafana stack (Loki, Tempo, Prometheus, Alloy) to observe complex backend workflows
